own_solution.law: Ideal entropy of mixing at equal T and P: dS = -R sum n_i ln x_i (each gas expands isothermally from V_i to V, V_i/V = x_i)
assumptions: rigid insulated container: Q = W = 0, so T unchanged
equal initial T and P so V_i proportional to n_i

defect_reasons.other: T6DA3/T2667 do not say the added helium is at the common temperature; the intended reading (same T, partition re-equalises pressure) is natural but implicit.

notes: Base: x_He = 0.375, x_Ar = 0.625; dS = 8.314*(1.5*0.980829 + 2.5*0.470004) = 8.314*2.646253 = 22.001 J/K. With 2.8 mol He: x_He = 0.528302, x_Ar = 0.471698; dS = 8.314*(2.8*0.638087 + 2.5*0.751416) = 8.314*3.665184 = 30.472 J/K. Container volume cancels (only V_i/V = x_i enters). Balloon helium and earlier-run helium have no path to the mixing. Numeral-free 'small amount' sentences are controls without a number.
